title: People's Socialist Republic of Albania
capsule: The People's Socialist Republic of Albania was the communist state established under Enver Hoxha after World War II. It pursued an isolationist Stalinist course, breaking successively with Yugoslavia, the Soviet Union, and finally China. The regime collapsed amid the wider fall of European communism around 1991.
